entities.name: Short Message
entities.description: A field in paging messages that carries short indications to UEs about system modifications, notifications, and monitoring instructions.

entities.name: systemInfoModification
entities.description: Bit 1 of Short Message; when set to 1, indicates a BCCH modification other than SIB6, SIB7 and SIB8.

entities.name: etwsAndCmasIndication
entities.description: Bit 2 of Short Message; when set to 1, indicates an ETWS primary notification and/or an ETWS secondary notification and/or a CMAS notification.

entities.name: stopPagingMonitoring
entities.description: Bit 3 of Short Message; when set to 1, indicates that the UE may stop monitoring PDCCH occasion(s) for paging in this Paging Occasion, applicable only for shared spectrum channel access with specific configuration.

entities.name: systemInfoModification-eDRX
entities.description: Bit 4 of Short Message; when set to 1, indicates a BCCH modification other than SIB6, SIB7 and SIB8, specifically for UEs using eDRX cycle longer than the BCCH modification period.

entities.name: Bits 5-8 Unused
entities.description: Bits 5 to 8 of Short Message are not used in this release and shall be ignored by the UE if received.

relations.description: Short Message contains bit 1 for systemInfoModification indication.
Short Message contains bit 2 for etwsAndCmasIndication.
Short Message contains bit 3 for stopPagingMonitoring.
Short Message contains bit 4 for systemInfoModification-eDRX.
Short Message contains bits 5-8 which are unused and ignored.
